definition: a chain of flowers worn or hung as decoration
description: At sunset beside a lake, a young woman in a white dress with a ring of flowers on her head ties a red ribbon to a tall birch pole that is wrapped in leaves and flowers. Four women, each wearing a flower ring on her head, then push the decorated pole upright against the orange sky. In the last shots a group of young people in the same flower rings hold hands and dance in a circle around the standing pole in a meadow of grass and wildflowers.

en.question: What are the young women doing?

de.answer: Sie tanzen um die geschmückte Stange.

es.answer: Están bailando alrededor del poste decorado.
